title: The Home agent behind an external chat, through the page's own routes
request: The owner (2026-10-25): DCLab Code, a minimal developer app like Claude Code and Codex, must carry every capability of the R&D project behind its chat: "all agentic systems we designed work behind the chat, as Claude's or Codex's do"; then "most things are available: implement, adopt and integrate them, no need to make them again"; "the main repo" is this R&D repository (Research_Development_DCLab), not the main product repository.
plan: a chat scope in the registry with its own guard
wait for the agent's turn and return what the page shows
record the chat's text apart from a person's
tests over MCP on files and PostgreSQL
adversarial review, then fix and review again

decisions.decision: The tools go through the page's routes in the same app (httpx ASGITransport), not the agent objects: the routes already own the busy check on both stores, the background turn, the twin hook and the refusals; calling the objects re-implemented them badly (review findings 2, 4, 8, 10).
decisions.why: the routes own the checks; a re-implementation missed four of them (review findings 2, 4, 8, 10)

decisions.decision: A chat builds only through home_build, with the person's own words read by the Home agent's asks_to_build; home_message refuses words that ask to build, so the host (DCLab Code) can ask the person before the one holdout read.
decisions.why: the host can only ask before a step it can see; one tool makes the holdout read visible

decisions.decision: Text an external chat sends is that model's words: surface mcp on every event of an MCP call (a contextvar the route's tasks and threads inherit), draft.created gains surface (experience contract v14), and the conversations set leaves such drafts out (the owner's rule: another model's text is kept apart from a person's).
decisions.why: the owner's rule: another model's text is kept apart from a person's, never taught as theirs

decisions.decision: A file path is read on the server's machine: only without sign-in, never sealed/holdout (whole words, absolute and resolved paths), hidden, secret-looking, or inside DCLab's own folders; the bytes go through the page's upload route.
decisions.why: the path is read as the server's user, where keys and other workspaces live

decisions.decision: dclab-core's version bump coordinated with another session working in the same tree: it took 0.115.0, this change 0.116.0.
decisions.why: two sessions edit dclab_core in one tree; one version each, the other session first

change: dclab_rnd/chat_agents.py (home tools, async, _route/_settle/_path_refusal), registry scope chat, mcp_server dispatch with experience.via('mcp'), draft.api.turn_held shared by the route and the chat, draft.created surface, data_failed names its asset, experience.chat_surface in the hooks; dclab_core experience v14 and datasets.conversations skip surface mcp.

findings.defect: home_add_data read any file the server could read
findings.scenario: a token-holding caller passed <agent_home>/workspaces/<B>/drafts/<id>/data/clean.parquet, or a kaggle.json, and it became this workspace's table
findings.cause: a path was checked only for existence, suffix and sealed words
findings.fix: refused with sign-in on, inside DCLab's folders, hidden or secret-looking; bytes through the upload route

findings.defect: on PostgreSQL _busy always said not busy
findings.scenario: home_status.answering stayed false while the page's turn ran; home_message waited silently on pg_advisory_lock
findings.cause: the PostgreSQL turn lock has acquire (a probe) but no release, and _busy required both
findings.fix: draft.api.turn_held shared with the route, plus services.draft_tasks

findings.defect: home_add_data returned before the agent read the table
findings.scenario: with refresh_offers slowed by 2 s the tool returned status ready with no message; the 'Which column is the outcome?' question came later, unseen
findings.cause: the pipeline marks the table ready, then refreshes offers, and only then starts the agent's data_ready turn
findings.fix: wait for the agent's message on that asset (data_failed now names it) and a free turn

findings.defect: no timeout and a thread held per waiting call
findings.scenario: home_start/message/build ran the whole turn inside the MCP call, each holding a thread of the pool every route's to_thread shares
findings.cause: synchronous handlers running the turn themselves
findings.fix: async tools through the routes; _settle polls with asyncio.sleep up to TURN_WAIT_S and says the agent is still working

findings.defect: the chat's text recorded half as the agent's, half as the person's, and taught as a person's
findings.scenario: draft.created had actor agent but every home_message became chat.person surface home; the conversations builder used draft.created's problem as a user turn whatever its actor
findings.cause: no channel on the events
findings.fix: experience.via('mcp') and chat_surface; draft.created surface (v14); the builder skips surface mcp
findings.test: tests/test_chat_agents.py::ChatConversationsKeptApartTests and the surface checks in the build test

findings.defect: home_build read the holdout on the external model's own call
findings.scenario: the chat's model called home_build; quick_build started the five stages, the last reading the holdout, with no record that the person asked
findings.cause: the build route was called directly
findings.fix: person_words required and read by asks_to_build, sent as the person's message; home_message refuses build words

findings.defect: question options dropped
findings.scenario: the page showed three option buttons; the chat got only the question's text
findings.cause: view kept field and text only
findings.fix: options returned (the Home agent's own words; it never sees cell values)

findings.defect: some errors escaped as raw MCP errors
findings.scenario: HTTPException from job_room, charge_upload or submit came back as an MCP error, not {error}
findings.cause: the tools called the services directly
findings.fix: route statuses mapped to {error, status}

findings.defect: the sealed-name check was easy to miss or over-trigger
findings.scenario: a symlinked folder named sealed passed; hold-out and hold_out passed; a folder named unsealed was refused
findings.cause: substring check on resolved parts only
findings.fix: whole-word pattern on absolute and resolved parts

findings.defect: the twin was skipped
findings.scenario: with the owner's twin switch on, a draft driven over MCP left gaps in Claude's lane
findings.cause: the routes call twin_after; the tools did not
findings.fix: the tools go through the routes

findings.defect: a bare yes relayed by home_message could build without the host asking
findings.scenario: the agent offers to build, the chat sends 'yes' with home_message, the Home agent builds; DCLab Code only asks before home_build or build words
findings.cause: asks_to_build reads a yes after an offer as an order
findings.fix: home_message refuses whatever asks_to_build reads as an order to build

findings.defect: the event vocabulary refused a new field
findings.scenario: recording draft.created with a 'via' field dropped the event
findings.cause: the frozen contract lists each kind's fields
findings.fix: no ad hoc field: a versioned surface field (v14)

findings.defect: the person was asked twice to build
findings.scenario: live, DCLab Code: Claude passed the person's literal words 'I want it built.'; the Home agent does not read them as an order, so home_build refused after the person approved, and Claude asked again with 'build it'
findings.cause: person_words said only 'quoted'; the Home agent reads orders by its own rule (build_order)
findings.fix: person_words names the words the Home agent reads, and to pass 'build it' when the person said it another way

findings.defect: the orchestrator's answers reached the chat empty
findings.scenario: live: asked for the result, the Home orchestrator answered with two result cards and one line of text; the chat saw the line only and dug the numbers out of get_results
findings.cause: view() passed each message's text, not its card
findings.fix: chat_agents._card: each card's title, facts and table (cards never hold a table's row)

findings.defect: a build could still happen without home_build
findings.scenario: dclab_call POST /api/drafts/{d}/messages {text: build it} built a project; on a built draft, home_message 'the outcome should be housing' then 'yes', 'yes', 'Yes, build it' had the orchestrator build a new version
findings.cause: home_message's refusal only covered unbuilt drafts, and the bridge allowed the draft message and build routes
findings.fix: build_from_chat (every chat-driven build) refuses during an MCP call unless home_build's chat_build grant is set; the bridge refuses those routes

findings.defect: letter case got around the workspace-folder rule on macOS
findings.scenario: a path into the workspace with one folder name upper-cased passed _path_refusal
findings.cause: is_relative_to compares strings; the Mac file system ignores case
findings.fix: compare folders by the file system's identity (device and inode) on the given and resolved path

findings.defect: the secret-name rule refused ordinary tables and missed held-out names
findings.scenario: kaggle_house_prices.csv, tokens.parquet, secretary_survey.csv refused; held_out.csv accepted
findings.cause: a substring pattern
findings.fix: exact key-file names (kaggle.json, credentials.json, .env, id_rsa, *.pem...); held[-_ ]?out added

findings.defect: every route a chat ran started a fake web visit
findings.scenario: one flow recorded three visit.started {surface: web} as a person
findings.cause: the inner requests carried no visit, and a fresh visit was marked web
findings.fix: the bridge forwards the MCP call's visit; a fresh visit on /mcp or inside a chat's call is marked mcp

findings.defect: make check-quick would have failed
findings.scenario: tests/test_lineage.py expected experience v13; docs/DATA_CATALOG.md and data_catalog.json were stale
findings.cause: the contract bump missed two test lines and the generated catalog
findings.fix: v14 in the tests; make catalog

findings.defect: a turn a job ran lost the chat's surface
findings.scenario: after home_add_data the pipeline job's data-ready message was recorded with surface home (1 of 5 chat.agent events)
findings.cause: worker threads start without the request's contextvars
findings.fix: experience.origin() carries the channel; the worker re-enters experience.via for the job (never the build grant)
findings.test: tests/test_chat_agents.py (every chat.agent event of a chat's draft says mcp)

findings.defect: home_start could return before the agent's opening message
findings.scenario: in a loaded parallel run the draft was read before its first turn began, the busy check said free, and the tool returned no message
findings.cause: waiting only on a free turn
findings.fix: home_start waits for the agent's opening message too, as home_message and home_add_data wait for theirs

measurements.name: chat agents tests
measurements.gate: every test passes on files and PostgreSQL; each review finding has a test that fails without its fix
measurements.result: tests/test_chat_agents.py 10 of 10; 20 related files 454 tests on files; 7 files 204 tests on PostgreSQL

measurements.name: live check through DCLab Code
measurements.gate: a live session reaches the Home agent, its orchestrator, the workspace tables and the bridge, under a $1.50 cap
measurements.result: all four reached in 2 turns, $0.29 (Sonnet 5.5); ROC-AUC 0.8047 (0.789 to 0.822) read once; 4 findings, fixed

measurements.name: live rerun through DCLab Code
measurements.gate: the orchestrator's result reaches the chat from its cards; one build ask
measurements.result: Claude quoted the Evaluator card (ROC-AUC 0.8047, 0.789 to 0.822, 9,043 rows, read once); one build ask; $0.28

outcome: An external chat starts a Home draft, answers its questions, gives it a table, builds it on the person's words and talks to the built project's orchestrator, with the page's own checks; its words are recorded as a chat's, apart from a person's.
lessons: Integrate through the product's routes, not its objects: the routes carry the checks a re-implementation forgets.
A guard on the host is only as good as the single path it watches: make the dangerous step one tool.
Another model's words entering a training set as a person's is a data bug; mark the channel where the request enters.
risks: the data pipeline job may run outside the MCP call's context: its data_ready message is recorded with surface home (the conversation is skipped as a whole by draft.created's surface)
